changelog:
@Announcements Ping Retro Rewind v6.11.3 has been released! This update is required to continue to play online!

# ⚙️ Other Updates ⚙️  
```- SW2 Rainbow Road now has unique brstms for each section, as well as a custom final lap jingle and a custom first place soundtrack! Credits to ImZeraora for making this feature!
- Removed Charaname.txt functionality and replaced it with a custom bmg file. Updated tool and tutorial link will be posted below!```

# 📺 Channel Updates 📺
```- Raised the maximum amount of files able to be loaded.```

# 🐜 Bug Fixes 🐜 
```- Fixed an issue where users kept consistently disconnecting when playing online in bigger lobbies.
- Fixed an issue where patches would crash the game when loading to RWFC if a lot of mods were used.```


Download: https://update.rwfc.net/RetroRewind/zip/RetroRewind.zip
Updated character tutorial: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1zw8ErpxE14lk2p8G37mFr9FFHKF17pf5
Character name tool: https://zachpl-mk.github.io/charaname-creator/

Please report any and all bugs to <#1263952604363362449> channel! This should be the last hotfix now!
